newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks edge lower in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks edge lower in dull trade.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed a shade lower on Monday as investors appeared more interested in the upcoming holiday season, brokers said.
The all-share index closed one point down at 597.5. Hatton National Bank fell five rupees to 240 and National Development Bank five rupees to 196.
"The holiday sentiment is the over-riding factor," said Sarinda Unamboowe, a trader at brokerage John Keells.
Small retail investors as well as local and foreign institutional buyers were more involved in making holiday plans than buying stocks, he said.
Turnover was a low 8.14 million rupees on 282,314 shares.
A parcel of 11,600 Central Finance which traded at 235 rupees each was the main trade of the day.
